value.rationale: This is a complete, naturally motivated distributional description of the first aperiodic polygon-pair symplectic billiard's original-map return clock, whose roof is unbounded. Despite nonperiodicity and heavy-tailed single-stage durations, dyadic full-block time has exactly fixed variance 32; every prescribed deep staircase appears exactly once per complete block. These stark and exact physical iteration properties distinguish deterministic odometer sampling from renewal/Poisson heuristics and are not an arbitrary numerical parameter slice. Mathematical importance is this precise return-time observable, not an unsupported theorem for arbitrary billiards.
